author: hasl
body:
This has been an issue for way to long: the senior staff using "Not up to senior staff standards" to deny an application. It's cheap, lazy and most importantly unfair for the applicant; it shuts them out without them knowing why.

Not sure if you guys find it ok or not, so I'm making this for feeeeeeeeeedback.

Thanks,
Aura.

replies.author: gobernment
replies.body:
I'd like to make a statement, if I may.

This entire concept of "not up to senior standards" is indeed a lazy response. The senior staff have talked about it with each other and will ensure that future applications will get more elaborate responses than just that simple sentence: as there is no defined answer of "senior standards", nor any clarification prior of what to expect as a staff member, it's kind of sudden that it'd be given in the first place. Might I add, a bit indirect too.

Our selection process works solely off of senior and mentor opinions: we will have a few select moderators vote, as well as the senior staff individually cast their votes with reasons for pretty much every single one. Whether the feedback is positive or negative, the player should have the right to also know what they did wrong, considering they're the ones who are offering to serve and volunteer. If we do not tell them their mistakes, then, quite bluntly, they can't improve. While I may say that some senior responses may be harsh like that, we do in the end have typical reasons backing it.

The way it has been conveyed has been widely regarded as a bad move, especially since Howsie was around, so I'd like to see a stop to it. Whether it can also be regarded as irresponsible, negligent, or informal, it's in mine (and others) best interest to not continue this process.

Now, with that said, to those who have already received a response solely off of "Not up to senior standards", I am willing to talk with you on Skype so you can get the actual answer. By offering this service, I expect you to be rational and mature. My skype is miaeeno, as stated in the interview thread, and I welcome any questions that you may have. Keep in mind that evidence may not necessarily be provided, as in general it would be only for a physical copy (logs, recordings, etc.) of interviewees, which we do not really do, opposed with just a denial that outlines behavioral traits.

I also apologize for this, on behalf of myself and the seniors included, but I will be closing this thread to ensure that no drama persists, and that no further negativity is thrown around. I'd much prefer that staff complaints go to me or Midnight, as it seems there's traces of complaints in the thread.

This discussion is no longer relevant to the server.
